entries.name: torch
entries.reason: Torch 2.10/PyG CPU checkpoint and training checks pass; later releases omit required compiled extensions. A separate runtime migration is needed for Torch 2.13.

entries.name: setuptools
entries.reason: Torch 2.11.0 requires setuptools<82. The recorded advisories concern source-package construction on macOS and legacy wheel installation on Windows; this reviewed runtime targets Linux and does neither. Keep the version findings visible pending the upstream Torch update.

entries.name: torch
entries.reason: ESM 3.4.2 requires Torch >=2.11,<2.12. This optional Linux preprocessing runtime is disabled until an authorized encoder passes inference verification; it is not the platform runtime.

entries.name: transformers
entries.reason: ESM 3.4.2 requires Transformers >=4.57.6,<5. The fixed 5.10.4 platform no longer imports ESM; this optional runtime only loads the administrator-provided encoder, with tensor-only weights.
